transcript:
# City of Central Falls

## Board of Canvassers Meeting

Central Falls City Hall
580 Broad St. Central Falls, RI 02863
Tuesday, September 22, 2026
9 am

## Minutes

1. **Roll Call**

   The meeting was called to order at 9:07 am by Chair; Ryan Oldmixon, Belmiro Bala, Member; Candida Silva, Deputy City Clerk and Alberto DeBugo, City Clerk. A quorum was established

2. **Pledge of Allegiance**

   Chair, Ryan Oldmixon led the board in the pledge of allegiance.

3. **Board members will certify the results of the primary election held on Sept. 9, 2026**

   *The Board will vote on this item*

   A motion to certify the 2026 Primary Election was made by Member; Belmiro Bala and seconded by Chair; Ryan Oldmixo. Passed 2/0.

4. **Adjournment**

   Meeting called to adjournment at 9:09 am. The motion was made by Member; Belmiro Bala and seconded by Chair; Ryan Oldmixon. Passed 2/0.
